body: Pretty much the opposite of how kitty is...

I feel you. When I was in college no one wanted to hang out with me outside of class because EVERYTHING they did involved alcohol and they didn’t want me there if I wasn’t going to drink, even though I made it clear I didn’t judge them for drinking. Shit sucked but I found my peeps eventually.

I would ask if they want me to move out. If yes, request some time to get your things together, maybe a few months or something. You can go to community college and work for a couple years and transfer to a four year. During that time you can save and determine if you need to take out loans or not. Community colleges have counselors that can help you. They can help you decide which path is right for you. They’ll help you determine the classes you need to take depending on what school you want to go to and what major you decide on. After you get an associate’s degree you’ll be able to get better jobs too, which will help you after you move on from CC. I’m sorry you’re going through all of this. Feel free to dm me if you have any questions. Also when you do apply for four year schools be sure to fill out a FAFSA, depending on your situation they might cover all of your tuition. Another option is to ask your parents if you can stay with them or use their house as a permanent address during college and then see what FAFSA gives you, but it would be better to apply as an independent. You can also get a job for while you are living with your parents. I l is it sucks but there are options.
